description: Find Ghanaian statutes that implement a specific international directive, regulation, or convention. Input the document ID in "type:year/number" format (e.g., "regulation:2016/679" for GDPR). Returns matching Ghanaian statutes with implementation status and whether each is the primary implementing act.

eu_document_id.description: International document ID in format "type:year/number" (e.g., "regulation:2016/679" for GDPR, "directive:1995/46" for Data Protection Directive)

in_force_only.description: Return only statutes currently in force (default: false)

primary_only.description: Return only primary implementing statutes (default: false)

name: get_ghanaian_implementations
